activity.notes: From Berners-Lee's first Web proposal at CERN in 1989 to implementation of the first browser/editor and server by the end of 1990; this is the World Wide Web, not the Internet itself.

sources.title: The birth of the Web — CERN
sources.citation_text: CERN states that Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web at CERN in 1989 and had the first browser/editor, website, and server running by the end of 1990.
